note: Names, descriptions and grades are exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources by name; no guide text is copied from another guide.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through this guide's roadmap in order instead: finish the story, then the contact and stranger strands, then collectibles, then the activity grinds, and save the 100% completion trophy for last. If the platinum has not popped after the counter reads 54 of 55, re-check the one trophy the checklist still shows as unearned; the tracker in this app keeps that count for you. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the start of the game to its end. It is the first mission, so you will meet it within minutes of starting, and it teaches the basic movement, driving and fishing controls as you go. Missable only in the sense that it belongs to the opening: if you somehow skip past it, replay the mission from the mission replay menu rather than starting over. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapters end automatically once their last mission is done, so just keep following the story markers on the map and this trophy pops at the chapter's closing scene. It cannot be missed: story progress is never locked out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The chapter closes with its final mission, and the trophy pops as the chapter wraps up. Like every chapter trophy it is unmissable — keep playing the story and it comes. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the chapter where Vice City itself opens up most, so use the time between missions to start the open-world trophies — meditation spots, vehicle discovery and exploring new areas all count while the story is still running. The trophy pops when the chapter's last mission ends. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Before you start the chapter's final stretch, clear the missable partner trophies flagged in this guide — the story's later missions change who is available to ride with you. The trophy pops at the end of the chapter. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission. Treat it as the point of no return: finish every other missable trophy in this guide — the partner robberies, the VCIA departure and the showroom smash — before you start it, because the world changes after the finale. The mission itself is straightforward story play, and the gold trophy pops when its closing scene ends. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the Breakfast Run mission to the end. It is a story mission, so it appears on the map as the story advances; drive to its marker, follow the mission's beats, and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Replay it from the mission replay menu if you ever need to. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Play The Cartel Heist mission to the end. Heist missions have a setup phase and then the heist itself — finish both and the trophy pops at the mission's end. If you fail a section, the mission restarts from its checkpoint, so nothing here can be missed. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the Child's Play mission to the end. It unlocks as the story progresses; follow its marker, complete its objectives, and the trophy pops when the mission wraps up. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Play the Headliners mission to the end. It is a story mission tied to the music-scene strand of the plot; complete its objectives in order and the trophy pops at the mission's close. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Play the VCIA Takedown mission to the end. The mission takes you into the Vice City International Airport grounds; follow the objectives, deal with the airport security response, and the trophy pops when the mission completes. Do not confuse it with the separate open-world VCIA departure trophy — that one is a free-roam stunt, this one is the mission. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Play the Operation Savage Glory mission to the end. It is one of the larger set-piece story missions; work through its phases, use cover and the weapons the mission hands you, and the trophy pops when the operation is over. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's own stats screen. That means finishing the story, all stranger and contact strands, the collectibles, the activities and the hidden packages of side content the game counts — the in-game checklist is the authority, so open it regularly and clear whatever category still shows below 100%. Save this trophy for last: it is designed to pop after everything else on this list is nearly done, and it is the gold that stands between you and the platinum. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, long airtime, near misses in traffic, and clean landings all count toward the tally, which the game tracks for you. The fastest way is to chain them while driving normally: take highway ramps at speed, thread through traffic for near misses, and use the airport runways and the big jumps around Vice City for airtime. It adds up across the whole playthrough, so start early and let it build instead of grinding it in one sitting. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once: the shooting range, a race, fishing, an arcade game, bowling, a drone race, hunting, meditation and a stranger activity all count as types. You do not need to win or finish any of them — starting one of each is enough, and the trophy pops the moment the ninth type is sampled. Check them off in this app's tracker as you go so you can see which type is still untried. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range offers timed target drills across several weapon classes, and gold asks for both speed and accuracy — learn each drill's target pattern first with a slow run, then push for the gold time. Use the weapon the drill hands you rather than fighting it, aim for head-height targets in one smooth sweep, and retry a drill immediately when a run goes wrong instead of finishing a bad score. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida. Each location has its own course through rings and around obstacles; fly one practice run to learn the ring order, then race for the win, cutting corners only where the rings allow it. The trophy pops after the fourteenth location's win, and the app's checklist can hold your per-location wins if you tick them as you go. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street, off-road, boat and bike races each count, but the same race won twice still counts once, so keep moving to new events on the map. Pick a fast, stable car for street races, learn each course's sharp corners on the first lap, and use slipstream on the straights. The race menu shows which events you have already won, so work through it systematically. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are scored on the size and number of the catch, so pick a quiet spot, match the bait to the water, and keep the line tension in the safe zone instead of reeling hard — a snapped line costs the whole run. Cal's challenge unlocks through the fishing strand; once it is available, one clean win is all it takes. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one full arcade game at an arcade cabinet. Walk up to any cabinet, pick the shortest game on offer, and play it through to its end screen — score does not matter, only finishing. Arcades are scattered around Vice City's entertainment spots; one completed game pops the trophy. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Contact strands unlock gradually as the story advances — take Andy's calls and markers whenever they appear, work through his jobs in order, and the trophy pops when his last mission ends. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Kenton's jobs revolve around boats and the waterways; answer his calls, finish each job he hands out, and the trophy pops at the end of his last mission. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Billy's strand is the biker strand — expect bike chases and club business — and the trophy pops when his final mission is done. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark icons on the map — walk up to one, play through their whole chain of missions, and move on to the next. Eight completed strands pop the trophy, so pick the strands nearest your current story progress and keep a note of which ones you have finished; this app's tracker can hold that list. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy's jobs are supply runs — moving goods across Leonida under pressure — so take his markers as they appear and work the strand to its end for the trophy. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone's strand runs through the music and club scene; answer his calls, finish his jobs in order, and the trophy pops when his last mission ends. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Spots sit at scenic overlooks, beaches, parks and quiet corners of the map — walk up to one, start the meditation, and let the short sequence finish for the spot to count. Work through them region by region (Vice City first, then the countryside and the coast) and tick each off in this app so you can see which regions are still open. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting strand points you to a rare animal in a specific wilderness area — follow his directions, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly rather than scaring it off. If the animal flees, leave the area and come back later; the hunt stays available until the animal is taken. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are tucked into shops, houses, vehicles and hidden corners all over Leonida, and each set needs every card in it — the in-game collection menu shows which cards of a set you already hold, so use it to see what is missing before you go hunting. Clear one set fully before starting the next, and sweep each district as you pass through it during the story. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. Each spot counts once, so keep moving: open the app at landmarks, viewpoints, businesses and neighbourhood signs as you travel, and the counter climbs. The quickest route is to fold it into normal play — check in at every new place you visit during missions and exploration, and the hundred arrives on its own well before the endgame. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge menu. Challenges span driving, combat, exploration and activities, and they range from trivial to demanding — start with the easy ones (drive a distance, visit places, win a race) and let the harder ones fall as you chase the other trophies. The menu shows your progress per challenge, so pick off the nearest ones first. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner riding along, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Do it while your partner is still regularly available — early to mid story, before the finale changes the cast — in a fast car near the countryside, where you can break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Raise the heat with a robbery or a shootout, keep your partner in the car, then drive off-road and stay out of sight until the wanted level drops. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three close-together shops in Vice City first, keep the same wanted level running between robberies, and do not let the stars clear or the run resets. Do it while your partner is available in the story — before the finale — and use a fast getaway car parked outside each shop. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a new vehicle for the first time counts it — cars, bikes, boats, trucks and aircraft all add to the tally, which the game tracks for you. The fastest way is variety: drive everything you pass, visit dealerships, marinas and the airport, and take story vehicles when missions hand you something unusual. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies bunch together — a mission firefight or a police standoff — then trigger Combat Focus and work through five targets before the effect ends. Pick a weapon with a fast fire rate and keep moving between targets instead of lingering on one. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — steal a plane and take off without going through the airport's normal flow. This belongs to the airport story sequence: when a mission brings you airside at VCIA, grab a plane on the runway and get airborne instead of following the scripted exit. If you finish the airport missions without doing it, replay the airport mission from the mission replay menu. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — the trophy is about surviving and beating the army's armour when it rolls in at high wanted levels. Get to 5 stars, let a Rhino arrive, then take it out with sticky bombs on its hull or heavy weapons from cover, and stay mobile so its cannon cannot pin you down. It pops once you have handled the tanks the game throws at you. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: enter outside peak attention, move slowly, avoid the staff's line of sight and the cameras, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If a clerk spots you, the attempt fails — leave, let the heat die down, and try again with a slower approach. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Vaults are the big robberies of the open world: case the bank, get inside, crack the vault, grab the cash and break out through the police response to a waiting car. Do them one at a time with a fast car parked close by, and keep a route in mind before you go in — the escape matters as much as the vault. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol set routes around Leonida — ambush one on a quiet stretch, stop it with a ram or an explosive, blow the rear doors, take the cash and get clear before the police close in. A fast car and a planned escape route turn a messy robbery into a clean one. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel, and an area counts once you have driven through its heart — cities, towns, swamps, beaches and the countryside all count. Sweep the map district by district in a fast car or a plane, watching the area name appear on screen, and use the in-game map to spot the blank patches you have not visited yet. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own rackets in its own turf — find one operation per gang, hit it, and get out with the take. Gang territory is marked by who hangs around it, so work through the map gang by gang and tick each one off in the tracker as you clear it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take it in with the ocean in front of you — the trophy pops once the drink and the view come together. It is a quiet moment trophy, available any time you can reach the beach, so fold it into an early visit to Vice City. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out onto the street. This belongs to a story moment inside a dealership: when a mission puts you behind the wheel inside a showroom, do not look for the exit door — floor it through the glass instead. If you leave the showroom politely, replay that mission from the mission replay menu and take the loud way out. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Walk in, rent a lane, and follow through a full game — the trophy is about the follow-through, so finish the game rather than quitting halfway. Bowling is also one of the 9 activity types, so it counts toward Master of None too. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach a partnership moment with mass appeal — a public moment with your partner that the city notices. Play the partner strand: spend time with your partner, do their activities and missions together, and the trophy pops when the partnership hits its big public beat. It comes naturally from playing the partner content, so do not force it. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — the game tracks them, up to a count of 500, and the trophy pops as the tally fills. Choices appear in dialogue, in mission decisions and in how you treat people across Leonida, so play decisively instead of standing still: pick an answer, take a side, act. Some choices are one-time, so think before you pick, but the count is generous and builds across the whole playthrough. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something you first failed — the trophy is about the second time being the charm. It is tied to a specific second-chance event in the world: fail it once, then come back and clear it on the retry. If you clear it first time, the trophy stays locked until another second-attempt moment comes around, so do not worry — keep playing and it will find you. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's nod to the unexplained, out in the wilds of Leonida. Strange sightings happen at particular spots and times, usually at night and away from the city; visit the remote corners of the map after dark, keep your eyes on the sky and the treeline, and the trophy pops when the moment finds you. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl the target over. Find a pedestrian on a quiet street, line the car up slowly, and swing as you pass; speed helps the knockdown but control matters more, so go slow enough to land the hit. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to a contact who cleans money, and each cleaned batch counts toward the $250,000 total. Rob banks, vaults and armored trucks to keep the bills flowing, and clean them in steady batches rather than sitting on a pile. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Clothes, weapons, car mods, food and ammo all count, and the total adds up across every shop — so buy what you actually use and the trophy arrives on its own. If you want it faster, spend a chunk on a high-end car upgrade or a wardrobe refresh once your robbery money is flowing. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale through the property listings — buy each one as it appears, from the small lockups to the big multi-car spaces, and the trophy pops when the eighth deed is yours. They double as storage for your vehicle collection, so they pay for themselves. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles, PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone while sitting in a vehicle, register it, and move on to the next — any ten vehicles count, so use the ones already in your garage plus a few you find on the street. The trophy pops at the tenth registration. Sources: Exophase, PSNProfiles.
trophies.name: On the Spot
